name: Royal Flush: Bright
source:
University senior Allison Little feels lost amongst her peers as they move towards the next chapter of their lives, graduation. Until it all comes crashing down on her with one accident. When she wakes up on an abandoned beach, she soon realizes she’s far from home. Now Allison must find her way in this strange new world all while trying to figure out why she’s there in the first place. But with a tyrannical queen causing a world of chaos, the people of Wonderland have their own problems to solve…

Could this be why she's here?

From [url=https://star-sundae.itch.io/royal-flush-bright]itch.io[/url]
translation:
大学即将毕业的Allison Little看着同学们迈向人生新阶段，感到迷茫。直到一场意外让一切轰然崩塌。她在一处荒废的海滩醒来，很快发现自己身处远离家乡的地方。如今Allison必须在这个陌生的新世界中寻找出路，同时弄清自己为何会来到这里。然而，暴虐的女王正令整个世界陷入混乱，仙境居民也有自己的难题要解决……

这会是她来到这里的原因吗？
